mapper.sql: p.progress_id, p.user_id, p.story_id, p.current_node_id, p.slot_no, p.status, p.history, p.ending_count, p.create_time, p.update_time, s.title AS story_title
mapper.select: SELECT FROM game_progress p JOIN story s ON p.story_id=s.story_id WHERE p.progress_id=#{progressId}
SELECT FROM game_progress p JOIN story s ON p.story_id=s.story_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.story_id=#{storyId} ORDER BY p.update_time DESC
SELECT FROM game_progress p JOIN story s ON p.story_id=s.story_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.story_id=#{storyId} AND p.status=0 ORDER BY p.update_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT , n.node_text AS current_node_text, n.ending_title AS current_ending_title FROM game_progress p JOIN story s ON p.story_id=s.story_id LEFT JOIN story_node n ON p.current_node_id=n.node_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY p.update_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_progress (user_id, story_id, current_node_id, slot_no, status, history, ending_count) VALUES (#{userId},#{storyId},#{currentNodeId},#{slotNo},#{status},#{history},#{endingCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE game_progress SET current_node_id=#{currentNodeId}, status=#{status}, history=#{history}, ending_count=#{endingCount} WHERE progress_id=#{progressId}
